points.description: States that the statement is FALSE (the OS does not execute the next instruction after the faulting one). Equivalent wording such as 'incorrect' or 'false, it re-executes the faulting instruction' earns this mark.

Explains that after the handler creates the mapping (allocates the physical page and updates the page table) it returns, and the faulting instruction is re-executed because the PC is not incremented on a page fault. Equivalent wording and any correct alternative explanation earn the mark. Merely saying the mapping update is 'only part' of the handler, without the re-execution point, does not earn this mark.
